podcast.body: This song kicked off Aerosmith's career in 1973 as an "instant AOR radio staple" but only peaked at number 59 as a pop hit. It re-entered the Hot 100 in early 1976 and climbed to number six, becoming Aerosmith's first Top 10 hit and their first second chance hit. "Dream On had re-entered the Hot 100 in early 1976 and climbed all the way to number six. It was Aerosmith's first Top 10 hit and their first second chance hit."
